description: This file contains functions and data structures for building and exporting curriculum data, including handling superblocks, chapters, modules, and challenges, as well as writing related JSON files to the filesystem.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Generic interface representing a curriculum block with challenges and metadata.

classes.name: GeneratedBlock
classes.description: Interface representing a generated curriculum block with a dashed name, intro, and metadata.

classes.name: GeneratedChapter
classes.description: Interface representing a generated chapter with modules and blocks.

classes.name: GeneratedModule
classes.description: Interface representing a module within a chapter, containing blocks.

methods.name: buildExtCurriculumDataV2
methods.description: Main function to generate and write curriculum data files based on the provided curriculum object.

methods.name: parseCurriculumData
methods.description: Parses curriculum data and writes superblock JSON files.

methods.name: buildChapterBasedCurriculum
methods.description: Builds and writes JSON data for chapter-based curriculum superblocks.

methods.name: buildBlockBasedCurriculum
methods.description: Builds and writes JSON data for block-based curriculum superblocks.

methods.name: buildChallengeFiles
methods.description: Generates challenge JSON files for each challenge in a superblock.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Helper to write JSON data to a specified file path.

methods.name: getSubmitTypes
methods.description: Writes submit challenge types to a JSON file.

methods.name: getSceneAssets
methods.description: Writes scene asset data to a JSON file.
